IS 12308 : Part 11 : 2025 Methods for Chemical Analysis of Cast Iron and Pig Iron - Part 11 Determination of Total Carbon by the Direct Combustion Volumetric Method (for Carbon 1.50 Percent to 4.50 Percent)
ICS 77.080.10
ICS 77.080.10
MTD 34
MTD 34
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 11) describes the volumetric method for determination of carbon in the range of 1.50 percent to 4.50 percent in cast iron and pig iron.
2 REFERENCE
The standard given below contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication the edition indicated was valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of this standard:
